# CG-RES-011: Response value constraint relaxed

A constraint on response values became looser.

**Why it matters:** Consumer limits are unknown.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Direction | response |
| Detects | `schema.constraintChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: low · undetermined: low |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> `{keyword}` was relaxed in {where}.
>
> Values outside the previous limit may now be returned; consumer buffers or UI limits may not handle them.
>
> **Fix:** Confirm that consumers handle the wider range.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: maxLength 50 → 255

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, maxLength: 50}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, maxLength: 255}}}}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, low. `maxLength` was relaxed in GET /x: response 200 (application/json).

### Fires: maximum removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: integer, maximum: 10}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: integer}}}}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, low. `maximum` was relaxed in GET /x: response 200 (application/json).

### Does not fire: tightened

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, maxLength: 255}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, maxLength: 50}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Consumer buffer sizes and UI limits are unknown.
